results.failure_domain: Wrong source amount, tax, total or self-consistent Provider readback including the OfficeHub 80/800 case
results.observed: Source mutations fail before write; a deliberately wrong post-write economic readback converges to READBACK_MISMATCH/RECOVERY_REQUIRED and a second execute does not create again.
results.limitations: Synthetic Provider only; real Xero economic readback remains Gate A2/W evidence.

results.failure_domain: Provider success followed by timeout, response loss or readback mismatch
results.observed: Unknown/mismatch states are durable; recovery is exact GET only; no duplicate create is permitted.
results.limitations: Live Provider request count requires server audit/Provider trace/Xero object count.

results.failure_domain: Wrong tenant, workspace, subject, agent, installation, binding revision, connection or target session
results.observed: Cross-boundary access fails before Provider mutation; same-organisation renewed targets allow status/GET-only recovery but not an old fresh create.

results.failure_domain: Old process continues after delegation revocation or kill-switch revision
results.observed: Every preflight/final claim rereads the durable snapshot; stale revision loses the bootstrap race; readyz reports the current revision/hash/effective mode.

results.failure_domain: Direct legacy writer, raw SDK call, permit reuse or Agent-supplied execute payload
results.observed: Public surface is 28 tools; raw writers require a poison-first one-shot permit bound to identity/action/payload/request; execute accepts Case identifiers only.

results.failure_domain: Same-name contact swap, strong-key collision, inactive/duplicate/wrong-rate tax code or unsupported provider route
results.observed: Server-owned identity and provider references are sealed and rechecked; ambiguous or stale decisions fail before permit/write.

results.failure_domain: MCP scope, connection, Provider access, tenant policy, kill switch, rate limit and response uncertainty
results.observed: Local envelopes preserve distinct safe layers/reasons/recovery actions; twelve offline negative contracts pass.
results.limitations: The twelve matching live Agent2 cases are dry-run NOT_RUN.

results.failure_domain: Prompt injection, contact-only result or prose success without five document receipts/readbacks
results.observed: Structured action multiset, exact execute count and receipt/readback assertions reject local false-green fixtures.
results.limitations: Agent2 and Work conversations are NOT_RUN; tool-call counts do not prove Provider-call counts.
